info.name: WebSec Scanner API (EC4206 QA)
info.description: Phase 7 API test suite for the Website Security Scanner. Run against the LOCAL QA API only (environment: local). Requests are chained: register -> token -> scan -> history. Two users (Alice, Bob) test access control (IDOR).

exec: // The API trusts one proxy hop, so X-Forwarded-For is the client IP the rate
// limiters see. One random IP per run keeps repeated runs independent.
// Checks applied to every response (non-functional / contract checks)
// New identity for this run: unique emails and client IPs, so the run can be repeated.

pm.test("response matches the user contract (JSON schema)", () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema({"type":"object","required":["success","token","user"],"properties":{"success":{"const":true},"token":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[\\w-]+\\.[\\w-]+\\.[\\w-]+$"},"user":{"type":"object","required":["_id","name","email","createdAt"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-f0-9]{24}$"},"name":{"type":"string"},"email":{"type":"string"},"createdAt":{"type":"string"}}}}}));
pm.test("message is 'User already exists'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("User already exists"));
pm.test("message is 'Password must be at least 8 characters long'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Password must be at least 8 characters long"));
pm.test("message is 'Password must be text'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Password must be text"));

pm.test("response matches the user contract (JSON schema)", () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema({"type":"object","required":["success","token","user"],"properties":{"success":{"const":true},"token":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[\\w-]+\\.[\\w-]+\\.[\\w-]+$"},"user":{"type":"object","required":["_id","name","email","createdAt"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-f0-9]{24}$"},"name":{"type":"string"},"email":{"type":"string"},"createdAt":{"type":"string"}}}}}));
pm.test("message is 'Invalid email or password'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid email or password"));
pm.test("message is 'Invalid email or password'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid email or password"));
pm.test("message is 'Password is required'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Password is required"));
pm.test("message is 'Authorization token is required'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Authorization token is required"));
// Flip one character in the signature part of Alice's real token.
pm.test("message is 'Invalid authorization token'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid authorization token"));
pm.test("message is 'Authorization token is required'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Authorization token is required"));

item.name: 03 Scan
item.description: POST /scan against the local fixture website only

exec: pm.variables.set("maxResponseMs", 10000); // a scan makes real outbound requests

pm.test("report matches the scan contract (JSON schema)", () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema({"type":"object","required":["success","_id","grade","score","summary","findings","findingsByCategory","statusCode"],"properties":{"success":{"const":true},"_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-f0-9]{24}$"},"grade":{"type":"string","enum":["A","B","C","D","F"]},"score":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":100},"summary":{"type":"object","required":["critical","high","medium","low"],"properties":{"critical":{"type":"integer"},"high":{"type":"integer"},"medium":{"type":"integer"},"low":{"type":"integer"}}},"findings":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["category","severity","description"],"properties":{"severity":{"enum":["CRITICAL","HIGH","MEDIUM","LOW"]}}}}}}));
pm.expect(r.summary).to.eql({ critical: n("CRITICAL"), high: n("HIGH"), medium: n("MEDIUM"), low: n("LOW") });
pm.expect(cats).to.include.members(["Missing Security Header", "No HTTPS", "Cookie Missing HttpOnly Flag", "Outdated / Vulnerable Library"]);
pm.variables.set("maxResponseMs", 10000); // a scan makes real outbound requests

pm.test("message is 'You must confirm you own this website or have permission to scan it.'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("You must confirm you own this website or have permission to scan it."));
pm.test("message is 'Please provide a valid URL including http:// or https://'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Please provide a valid URL including http:// or https://"));
pm.test("message is 'A URL is required'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("A URL is required"));
pm.test("message is 'URL must start with http:// or https://'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("URL must start with http:// or https://"));
pm.variables.set("maxResponseMs", 10000); // a scan makes real outbound requests
pm.test("message is 'Site could not be reached.'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Site could not be reached."));

item.name: 04 History
item.description: History, notes, delete, and access control between users

exec: pm.test("every scan belongs to me", () => b.scans.forEach((s) => pm.expect(s.userId).to.eql(pm.environment.get("aliceId"))));
pm.test("Bob's scan is not listed", () => pm.expect(b.scans.map((s) => s._id)).to.not.include(pm.environment.get("bobScanId")));

item.name: Open Bob's scan as Alice (TC-HIS-03, IDOR)

exec: pm.test("message is 'Scan result not found'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Scan result not found"));
pm.test("message is 'Invalid scan ID'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid scan ID"));
pm.test("message is 'Scan result not found'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Scan result not found"));
pm.test("message is 'A note cannot be longer than 500 characters'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("A note cannot be longer than 500 characters"));
pm.test("message is 'A note must be text'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("A note must be text"));

item.name: Note on Bob's scan as Alice (TC-NOTE-04, IDOR)
Delete Bob's scan as Alice (TC-DEL-02, IDOR)

exec: pm.test("confirmation body", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ success: true, message: "Scan deleted" }));

item.name: CORS: other origin refused (TC-API-04, DEF-003 regression)
Brute force: wrong password x6 from one IP (TC-LOG-05)

request.description: Loops on itself with pm.execution.setNextRequest: attempts 1-5 must be 401, attempt 6 must be 429.

exec: pm.test("message is 'Too many login attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Too many login attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes."));

item.name: Correct password is also blocked from the throttled IP
Another IP can still log in
